title: a11y(form designer): every field card's aria-roledescription is dnd-kit's English "sortable", whatever the locale
body:
**Filing gate ①: a measured defect, class (a): user-facing copy read to screen-reader users, left in English.** Reach: Studio → an object → the Form tab's designer, in zh-CN. Measured by the objectui#11802 dev in real Chromium (the same dev-only harness as objectui#11802; not committed).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage, grade and route. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 1 (`session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`) from the objectui#11802 dev report (out-of-scope finding 2).

## What happens

- Every field card in the form designer carries `aria-roledescription="sortable"` in English, whatever the locale.
- A screen reader reads it when the card takes focus.
- objectui#11802 localizes the drag announcements and instructions, but not this attribute: it sits outside that card's `DndContext`-props fence.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

- dnd-kit's `useSortable` sets `roleDescription: 'sortable'` unless it is given `attributes.roleDescription`.
- The designer's `SortableField` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`) passes none.

## Done when

- Each field card's `aria-roledescription` is a localized engine string (EN and ZH), passed through `useSortable`'s `attributes.roleDescription`.
- A pin reads the attribute in both locales.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui, *aria-roledescription sortable English untranslated useSortable roleDescription*: 0 hits.
- Positive control in the same session: *form designer keyboard drag no drop target …* returned objectui#11802.

Dedupe words: aria-roledescription sortable English · form designer card role description localized · useSortable roleDescription
